	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = GeneXus.TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated PrensadoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"PrensadoId"
					&Insert_PrensadoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated InterrupcionId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"InterrupcionId"
					&Insert_InterrupcionId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
